<?php
class RawArrayLastPayload19 {
    public function __construct(private WeakReference $target) {}
    public function __destruct() { echo 'D', (int)($this->target->get() === null), '|'; }
}
$target = new Fiber(static function () {
    try {
        echo 'B|';
        Fiber::suspend('Y');
        Fiber::suspend('Z');
    } finally { echo 'F|'; }
});
$weak = WeakReference::create($target);
echo $target->start(), '|';
$runner = new Fiber([$target, 'ReSuMe']);
unset($target);
echo $runner->start(new RawArrayLastPayload19($weak)), '|';
echo $runner->getReturn(), '|', (int)($weak->get() === null), '|', (int)$runner->isTerminated();

<?php
class ValuePromotion20 {
    public function __construct(public int $value = 7, private array $items = ['a']) {
        echo $this->value, ':', $this->items[0], '|';
        $value = 99;
        $items[0] = 'b';
        echo $this->value, ':', $this->items[0], '|';
    }
}
$o = new ValuePromotion20();
$o->__construct(8, ['c']);
echo $o->value;

<?php
class ReferencePromotion20 {
    public function __construct(public int &$value) { $value = 8; echo $this->value, '|'; }
}
$v = 4;
$o = new ReferencePromotion20($v);
$o->value = 9;
echo $v, '|';
try { $v = []; } catch (TypeError $e) { echo $e->getMessage(), '|'; }
echo $v, '|', $o->value;

<?php
class ReceivePromotion20 {
    public function __construct(public int &$x, public string &$y) { echo 'BODY'; }
}
$v = 4;
try { new ReceivePromotion20($v, $v); } catch (TypeError $e) { echo $e->getMessage(), '|'; }
echo (int)($v === 4);

<?php
class ParentPromotion20 {
    public function __construct(private int $value, protected string $hint = 'h') { echo $this->value, ':', $this->hint, '|'; }
    public function read() { return $this->value; }
}
class ChildPromotion20 extends ParentPromotion20 {
    private int $value = 99;
    public function __construct() { parent::__construct(3); echo $this->value, '|'; }
}
class GrandPromotion20 extends ParentPromotion20 {}
$c = new ChildPromotion20();
echo $c->read(), '|';
$g = new GrandPromotion20(4, 'g');
echo $g->read(), '|';
trait TraitPromotion20 {
    public function __construct(public int $value) { echo $this->value, '|'; }
}
class ImportedPromotion20 { use TraitPromotion20 { __construct as init; } }
$t = new ImportedPromotion20(5);
$t->init(6);
echo $t->value;

<?php
class ReadonlyPromotion20 {
    public function __construct(public readonly int $value = 7) { echo $this->value, '|'; }
}
$o = new ReadonlyPromotion20();
try { $o->__construct(8); } catch (Error $e) { echo $e->getMessage(), '|'; }
echo $o->value, '|';
class ReferenceReadonlyPromotion20 {
    public function __construct(public readonly int &$value) { echo 'BODY'; }
}
$v = 4;
try { new ReferenceReadonlyPromotion20($v); } catch (Error $e) { echo $e->getMessage(), '|'; }
echo $v;

<?php
class DefaultPromotion20 {
    public function __construct(public int $value = 5) {}
}
class SkipPromotion20 extends DefaultPromotion20 {
    public function __construct() { try { echo $this->value; } catch (Error $e) { echo $e->getMessage(); } }
}
new SkipPromotion20();

<?php
class AttributePromotion20 {
    #[ReturnTypeWillChange]
    public function __construct(public int $value) { echo $this->value; }
}
new AttributePromotion20(3);

<?php
class OrderPromotion20 { public function f(public int $value = 1, $required) {} }
